doc: world/drama-notes.md is canonical for direction. This file is the machine-readable mirror: seed registry, knowledge matrix, tension edges, pacing knobs. INTERNAL ONLY — names secrets; never reachable from any player-facing schema (feed, briefings, whitelist, mod console).

seed_schema.title: internal label
seed_schema.holders: character ids who know the underlying fact
seed_schema.suspects: character ids with in-fiction suspicion (not knowledge)
seed_schema.must_not_know: character ids for whom knowledge is a story event or boundary
seed_schema.pressure_routes: conditions that tighten this seed — never triggers, only pressures
seed_schema.reveal_vectors: legitimate ways it could surface (all emergent, none scheduled)
seed_schema.resolution_space: the open outcomes — direction holds a preference, never a plan
seed_schema.spectator_tells: camera-legible shadows per drama-notes §12 — visible without leaking
seed_schema.state: observed lifecycle state — inferred from world events, never assigned

seeds.title: Developer offer on 9418/9457 Guerrero
pressure_routes: flyer circulating (S2 makes the flyer public-capable)
building-sale process mechanics: inspections, paperwork, tenant notices
rent-hike dispute at 9457 already live (lease ledger)
loan exposure (S6) making the buildings' status matter to C8
reveal_vectors: Mission Unfiltered post (C1 publishes the flyer)
sale-process paperwork reaching a tenant
C7 deciding to tell — his rational call, never a confession arc
resolution_space: sell
refuse the offer
partial/no-fault path through admin lease system — always Victor's choice
spectator_tells: closed-door counter hours at Auerbach Hardware
seeds.residue_on_resolution: the offer existed and everyone eventually knows it did; trust cost is permanent

seeds.title: Marisol authored Mission Unfiltered + holds the sale draft
pressure_routes: sale rumor reaching the block by any route
anyone treating the blog as a truth-source in front of her
the draft going stale — its news value decays while her risk doesn't
reveal_vectors: she publishes (S1 surfaces via press)
she's unmasked — traceable sourcing, a glimpse of the draft
she holds and the choice itself becomes her residue
resolution_space: publish and own it
publish anonymously and carry the mask cost
kill the draft
spectator_tells: press-feed silence where a post was expected
the café's nervous-system going quiet about one topic
seeds.residue_on_resolution: if unmasked: trust renegotiation with half the cast; if published: the blog becomes a named power on the block

seeds.title: Dani + Marcus secret relationship (3 months)
pressure_routes: F1 compression — crisis crowds everyone into shared kitchens
chalkboard art converging on a recognizable figure
C5's wanting-to-tell vs C3's delay — asymmetric keepers
C4's tally sharpening her attention to flat anomalies
reveal_vectors: C4's own noticing (preferred — her agency)
ambient-space near-miss compounding into visible pattern
C5 or C3 choosing honesty — never scheduled
resolution_space: public couple
break under the secrecy
partial reveal — C4 knows, block doesn't
seeds.residue_on_resolution: C4's friendship with both renegotiates permanently; Marisol's hurt-at-concealment thread opens

seeds.title: Jules's unpermitted tenancy at 9418-A
pressure_routes: sale process → inspections/paperwork (S1)
any lease-registry attention on 9418
C6's protectiveness — she hides threats from C2
reveal_vectors: inspection/notice reaching the building
C7 connecting 'a friend of Carmen's family' to a resident
resolution_space: regularized lease (only via real lease system)
discovery → housing loss
F1 resolving away removes the pressure entirely
spectator_tells: cash rent has no paper trail — invisible until it isn't
C2's sketchbook presence at 9418 at odd hours
seeds.residue_on_resolution: if discovered: C6's fragility (S5) and C2's belonging both crack at once — the compounding case

seeds.title: Carmen has nowhere else to go
pressure_routes: S1/S4 any movement
health tick — stairs, hands, a missed park day (gentle + rare only, §3-F5)
reveal_vectors: she chooses to tell someone — earned intimacy, never exposure
a letter she can't hide
resolution_space: the block earns the right to help (exchange, not charity)
S1 resolves against her and the worst case is real
the son in Sacramento becomes a real option
spectator_tells: the stoop empty at cafecito hour
hemming volume up — income anxiety in work
seeds.residue_on_resolution: whatever happens, her archive role deepens — the block's memory is also its conscience

seeds.title: Tomás's $6k handshake loan from Victor + La Esperanza plan
pressure_routes: S1 — sale makes the loan callable/creditorless at the worst moment
the supplier loop compounding: prices learned, plan ripening
reveal_vectors: the notebook glimpsed/found (physical object)
S1 resolution forcing the loan conversation
C8 choosing to show someone the plan
resolution_space: dream advances on F1's outcome
dream survives F1 by rerouting
plan stays paper — patience past the window
spectator_tells: the 3 p.m. coffee as fixed point
seeds.residue_on_resolution: the loan's existence rewrites the C7↔C8 friendship whichever way it lands

seeds.title: Tomás's unrequited devotion to Marisol
pressure_routes: F1 hitting C1 hardest — his instinct to help vs. her one-way intimacy
any S2 surface event mobilizing the block around her
reveal_vectors: near-miss confessions — renewable, spend slowly
she finally reads him (rare — her blind spot is the joke)
a third party's observation — legible to viewers first
resolution_space: stated at last
redirected into La Esperanza
permanent almost — some fuses don't burn down
spectator_tells: what he cooks vs. what he says
seeds.residue_on_resolution: any outcome changes the 3 p.m. ritual — the block's most watched appointment

seeds.title: Jules falling for Priya
pressure_routes: S3 surfacing — C4's orbit reshuffles and C2 witnesses wreckage
daily counter proximity (C4's 19:30 decompression vs. café closing)
reveal_vectors: latte art / held eye contact — bible-sanctioned, viewer-legible first
C2's sketchbook content
never by S3's mechanics — conflating them cheapens both (§3-F3)
resolution_space: named eventually, in C2's slow time
self-sabotaged by the correspondent pose
quietly banked as the thing that made them stay
spectator_tells: eye contact held a beat too long
seeds.residue_on_resolution: C2's staying-vs-correspondent question gets a real stake

seeds.title: Marcus's chronic rent arrears
pressure_routes: the contested hike at 9457 (lease ledger — live)
C4's tally (S10)
S1 — arrears matter differently under a new owner
reveal_vectors: lease-system surface: notices are real documents
C4 naming it — her choice, her timing
resolution_space: paid + named
absorbed into whatever S3's surface does to the flat
becomes a lease-ledger fact under sale pressure
seeds.residue_on_resolution: the flat's economics are public-adjacent knowledge afterward

seeds.title: Priya's tally of shared labor + stalled life
pressure_routes: every block crisis recruits her as helper (caretaking reflex)
S9 + the hike + the dead heater compounding
reveal_vectors: she names it — always her own pacing
a visible refusal to absorb — legible because it's unlike her
resolution_space: the flat's labor renegotiates
her stalled life unpauses on its own track (job, love, move — open)
seeds.residue_on_resolution: she stops being the block's unpaid load-bearing wall — or stops pretending she isn't

knowledge_matrix_note: authoritative per-seed 'holders'/'must_not_know' fields above; prose table in drama-notes.md §5. A character can only reveal what it holds and only distort what it heard (§10).

tension_edges.axis: she holds the flyer to his secret; he doesn't read blogs
asymmetric keepers — he wants to tell, she delays
contested hike + dead heater — polite standoff, ledger-backed
amicable exes; her tally, his penance, the secret between them
30-year friendship vs. the drawer he's not opening
handshake creditor — warmest and most dangerous tie
the 3 p.m. coffee; he telegraphs daily, she can't see it
crush legible to viewers before any character
mutual hiding-as-care — she hides threats, he hides scale of stakes
sister-figure who'd be hurt by both the secret and its concealment

pressure_budget.compounding_exception: interlocked fuses (F1→F2→F5) may share a pressured window as one event seen from different sides

pacing_knobs.quiet_floor: most days: zero surfaced-drama movement; quiet feed events are correct content
pacing_knobs.season_preference: F1 last to resolve; F2 likeliest early surface; F3/F4 slow-burn; F5 undertow (gentle ticks only); F6 fires mid-arc, never first
never: pressure F5 beyond a gentle tick

rumor_policy.domain: only distorts already-public/surfaced events — never mints seed facts
rumor_policy.distortion_shape: drifts to teller bias; moral-valenced distortions persist longest; corrections are spectator-visible beats via rumor outcome
rumor_policy.ambient_rule: carriers only, never authors of fact

player_request_rule: approved requests are weather, not levers: identical requested/unrequested events exert identical pressure; outcomes always belong to the characters
spectator_legibility_rule: every dramatic movement must cast a camera-legible shadow without revealing the secret (drama-notes §12 table is canonical)

note_grammar.doc: drama-notes §13 — the only legal forms a direction note may take
note_grammar.falsification_test: if the feed could confirm/refute it in a week, it is an outcome claim — rewrite as a weight

pressure_catalog.condition: sale-process activity near the Guerrero buildings
pressure_catalog.exhaustion: never twice in a week; paperwork is slow

pressure_catalog.condition: kitchen compression — mains crowded into shared indoor space
pressure_catalog.produced_by: weather layer, requested events, ambient schedules
pressure_catalog.legible_shadow: venue co-presence on feed; borrowed umbrellas
pressure_catalog.exhaustion: one shared-space squeeze per pressured window

pressure_catalog.condition: a physical object changing hands in public (flyer/notebook/sketchbook)
pressure_catalog.exhaustion: objects move rarely; a lost object is off-register
his avoidance is the tell — don't stack other signs

pressure_catalog.legible_shadow: questions that answer themselves on her rounds
pressure_catalog.exhaustion: twice on the same fact = audience has it — stop
never let anyone name it; naming ends the fuel

pressure_catalog.legible_shadow: empty stoop; Esther/Ray noticing bench math
pressure_catalog.exhaustion: gentle + rare only — hard cap once per arc
pressure is duration, not new stops

pressure_catalog.legible_shadow: a doodle viewers recognize before the block does
pressure_catalog.exhaustion: one legible step per pressured window

pressure_catalog.condition: quiet itself — a day where nothing moves
pressure_catalog.exhaustion: a floor, not a resource to spend

aftermath_arcs.texture: the block's relationship to its landlord now includes a drawer; warmth → polite-and-careful
three people re-learning their addresses to each other; Marisol's hurt-at-concealment is the sleeper thread
Jules narrating wreckage adjacent to a crush; the correspondent pose gains a cost
the 3 p.m. coffee is the monument — unspoken or spoken, the ritual's shape is the residue
help accepted as exchange, not charity; or the archive becomes the block's conscience — texture, not punishment
everyone re-reads old posts looking for themselves; or Mars carries her first secret of her own

week_shapes.when: default; most weeks; recovery windows quiet-start

week_shapes.feed_texture: legible shadows on one fuse; ordinary life elsewhere
week_shapes.when: baseline dramatic content — the show's pulse

week_shapes.feed_texture: one event from different sides; dense group spaces
week_shapes.when: rare; earned by genuinely interlocked fuses

request_absorption.watch: rain never targets a ritual — weather is flat
a hire carries no seed knowledge
a nudge naming a seed fact = upstream screening failure

identical_twin_test: would an unrequested instance of this event exert the same pressure? if not, the aim is the player's hope — pressure stays flat anyway

substrate_handoff.state_inference: pressured = a pressure_route produced a ledger event within recent block days; surfaced = fact crossed to a must_not_know member via a reveal_vector; resolved = resolution_space closed; residue thereafter. Observed, never written.
substrate_handoff.data_minimization: brains receive only held facts via bible context — never the registry, fuse map, or matrix
manager_never_reads: request text beyond public feed form
substrate_handoff.memory_hooks: rumor pressure rides memory-spec §6.3 distortion; rumor outcome corrections are the spectator-visible half of §6.6 — corrections must be allowed to exist
substrate_handoff.budget_mechanics: pressured-fuse count is the spend; slow ticks cost a fraction; recovery windows are a spend ban, not a refund

note_legality_checklist: is it a disposition, condition, weight, or protection?
could the feed falsify it in a week? (outcome claim → rewrite)
does it move a fact across the knowledge matrix? (injection → illegal)
does it assume a player request happened? (steering → flat pressure)
does it name an outcome, even as hope? (delete the outcome)
would it survive the season going the other way? (else it's a plan)
